question:
10. We say that a sequence $\{a_n\}$ has property $P$, if there exists a positive integer $m$ such that $a_n\le1$ for every $n\ge m$. For each of the following sequences, determine whether it has the property $P$ or not. [Do not use any result on limits.]

(i)
\[
a_n=\begin{cases}0.9+\dfrac{200}{n},&\text{if $n$ is even},\\[4pt]\dfrac1n,&\text{if $n$ is odd.}\end{cases}
\]

(ii)
\[
a_n=\begin{cases}1+\dfrac{\cos\frac{n\pi}{2}}{n},&\text{if $n$ is even},\\[4pt]\dfrac1n,&\text{if $n$ is odd.}\end{cases}
\]
